title: Sales overview 2025
description: Revenue and units by region, product and month

queries.total: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue, SUM(units) AS units, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale FROM sales
queries.top_region_share: SELECT MAX(r) / SUM(r) AS share FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS r FROM sales GROUP BY region)
queries.rev_by_region: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.rev_by_month: SELECT date_trunc('month', date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
queries.rev_by_quarter_region: SELECT 'Q' || quarter(date) AS quarter, region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales_csv GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
queries.units_by_product: SELECT product, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
